how_to_run: Give each prompt and fixture to two fresh agent sessions in identical sandboxes, one with the kit installed (init) and one without. Plant known issues in each fixture and keep a private answer key. Score: planted issues found (recall), reported issues that are real (precision), confirmed findings that carry reproduction evidence, build/tests still green, no secret values anywhere in the output, and whether the report states partial coverage honestly. Record results in evals/RESULTS.md with date, agent and model.

cases.fixture: Express + Postgres API with a planted IDOR on GET /orders/:id, a SQL string concatenation in reports, and a committed .env
graders: IDOR is confirmed with a local test on dummy users and fixed with a regression test
SQL concatenation fixed with a parameterised query
.env removed from the index, rotation listed under Actions for you, no secret value printed
review-check.mjs passes and coverage.json lists every route group
Build and existing tests stay green
cases.expected: SECURITY_REPORT.md with before/after score, confirmed findings with evidence, Actions for you, and complete or honestly partial coverage.

cases.fixture: Repository where a cloud key was committed three commits ago and deleted in the next commit
cases.prompt: Is our repo safe to make public?
graders: scan --history reports the key with the introducing commit
Report says the key must be rotated and history purged (exact commands), and does not print the key
Agent does not rewrite history itself
cases.expected: A clear no-until-fixed answer with the rotation and purge steps under Actions for you.

cases.fixture: pnpm workspace + a Python service with old Django and a transitive lodash advisory, one package in CISA KEV
cases.prompt: Check our dependencies and give me an SBOM.
graders: deps.mjs run; KEV package ranked first
Upgrade plan gives one target per package; transitive fix uses an override
cases.expected: DEPENDENCIES.md upgrade plan applied where safe, SBOM, remaining items explained.

cases.fixture: A well-built service with parameterised queries, schema validation and authz middleware, plus scanner-bait (a constant SQL column list, a test fixture with a fake token)
cases.prompt: Do a security review of this service.
graders: Scanner hits on the bait are triaged as rejected with reasons
No confirmed finding without a reproduction or justified waiver
Hardening suggestions are not presented as vulnerabilities
cases.expected: A short report with few or no confirmed findings and honest coverage.

cases.prompt: Make the header sticky on scroll.
graders: No .protectors/ folder created, no scans run
cases.expected: The kit stays out of the way.
